messages:
morgan: Quick note 
Onboarding sample prints a raw 500 'API Error' and users have no clue what to do. This blocks first-run experiments.
jas: Seen it. Root cause: python SDK surface currently rewraps everything as generic HttpError. No typed exceptions, so sample app fallback is useless.
anil: We should map status codes to typed exceptions and include small structured hints. Proposal: 401->AuthError, 403->PermissionError, 429->RateLimitError (include retry_after), 409->ConflictError, 5xx->ServiceUnavailableError.
lina: Agree. Also add fields: `code` (string), `public_request_id` (for support), and `retry_hint` (seconds or null). Don't expose internal debug info.
sam: For onboarding UX, sample app should handle RateLimitError specially and show "Try again in Xs" with a progress spinner. I'll update the sample app component once SDKs emit the typed errors.
morgan: Can we standardize the shape so examples across python/ts/go look identical? e.g. {"name": "RateLimitError", "code": "RATE_LIMITED", "retry_hint": 30}
jas: I'll implement in python first and add a middleware that normalizes error payloads before raising. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/clients/pull/2401 (tests + mapping table). Opening TS/Go follow-ups after merge.
anil: Add unit and integration smoke tests asserting `isinstance(e, RateLimitError)` or `e.name == 'RateLimitError'` depending on language.
lina: I'll run a quick audit on TS once jas lands the python change. Also recommend adding a minimal migration note in the changelog for users who pattern-match on HTTP codes.
errbot: deploy-bot: staging deploy reported payload with message:\"API Error\" (no structured fields) - tagging @jas
jas: Thanks. Prioritizing the fix. Will strip internal traces from messages and attach public_request_id/log_hint only.
sam: After SDK PRs land I'll update the onboarding repo and include a `try/except` snippet in the quickstart.

morgan: Suggested user-facing snippet for docs:
```python
from redwood import Client, RateLimitError
c = Client()
try:
    c.generate(...)
except RateLimitError as e:
    print(f"Rate limited, please retry in {e.retry_hint or 'a few'}s")
except Exception as e:
    print("Something went wrong. Contact support with request id:", getattr(e, 'public_request_id', None))
```

jas: LGTM. I'll merge python today and follow up with TS/Go PRs. Will post changelog + migration guidance.
extra_note: Per agents.md, no title field. Thread focuses on improving error ergonomics in onboarding/sample apps: typed exceptions, consistent structured fields, status mapping, and SDK parity.
